checks.name: Reference identity and original fixture stay distinct from an external original
Unreviewed media and malformed timed descriptions are rejected
Bounded identities, tags and related notes are enforced
Public attribution URLs reject credentials and executable schemes
Related topic filtering covers the complete original list including empty
Route repeated and unknown values do not produce a fake empty result
Copied HTTP link excludes query and fragment note material
Versioned note record round trips only under its own reference identity
Notes are bounded plain text with valid timestamps
Export labels persistence boundaries and never invents an external source
Media provenance matches the original shipped file with decoded authoring evidence
Captions cover all three original descriptions

limitations: Fictional reference data and an original authored media fixture
No source footage, cloud persistence, native share or original external interaction acceptance
